reviewed_differences: EB01-074: all-enemy-players-each-choose: the binding marks the opponent's choice after_then=True with no 'Then' in the text (EB01-009 and GD05-049, same wording, have False)

EB01-078: each-player-in-turn-order-looks-at-top: the binding looks for you (LookTop, top0) then the opponent (wp_eb01_b_look_top_own, top1); the template's turn order (EB01-023's binding: active then standby, wp_eb01_a_look_own_top) is the same order for a 【Main】 Command, played by the active player, in other bytes

GD03-120: delayed-during-this-turn-when: the binding's trigger has no target filter and its selector lists HasTrait before IsRested; the compiler's 'destroys an enemy Unit' trigger has the Unit filter and its selector orders IsRested first
GD03-129: mill-top-of-deck: the binding checks that this Base is active before 'you may rest this Base'; the compiler's May(Rest) has no check (outside the template's sentence)
GD04-022: are-deployed-rested: the binding lists IsToken before the Lv. filter; the compiler keeps the text's order (the Lv. clause comes first)

GD05-130: exile-this-card-in-trash: 'If you do, you may deploy 1 Base card ... from your hand' is an optional choice in the binding and a May around a choice in the compiler (outside the template's sentence)
